old_value: {"id":"mimid-1wgh.37.37","title":"wg: rto-01 §4 PartialGroupInfo reconstruction unspecified","description":"Suggestion. §4 (L255-320) never says how to rebuild the GroupInfo (which epoch's GroupContext, where confirmation_tag comes from); hub and joiner must agree exactly for the signature to verify.
